image_description: A close-up shot of a black mannequin torso wearing two necklaces. The primary subject is a chunky, multi-strand necklace featuring large, irregular beads in shades of pale green, white, and magenta/purple, strung on wire or cord with silver-tone spacers. A secondary, thinner silver chain necklace is visible higher up on the neck. There is a white signature/logo watermark on the lower right of the black fabric.
